## Summary

I resolved ticket T-4003 by identifying a label mismatch between the cart-service deployment and its Service selector. The new Helm chart template in cart-service 4.2 uses Kubernetes recommended labels (`app.kubernetes.io/name`) but the Service selector wasn't updated to match, causing it to route to zero pods. The fix is to update the Service selector to use `app.kubernetes.io/name: cart-service` instead of `app: cart-service`.
